fail.message: Runtime API floor fixture missing: ${floor.file} (SHA-256 ${runtime.api.floor.paper.sha256}) is neither in the local Maven repository (${floor.local}) nor downloadable from ${floor.url}. The floor guard (RuntimeApiGuardTest) checks the framework against exactly this jar. If Paper has pruned the snapshot, replace the fixture: choose another published paper-api 1.19.2-R0.1-SNAPSHOT jar from that repository, set runtime.api.floor.paper.version and runtime.api.floor.paper.sha256 in pom.xml to its timestamped version and SHA-256 (sha256sum), and update RuntimeGuardConfigurationTest. Offline: place the original jar at ${floor.local}.

Runtime API floor fixture changed: ${floor.jar} has SHA-256 ${floor.actual}, but pom.xml records ${runtime.api.floor.paper.sha256} for ${floor.file}. Delete target/runtime-api-floor and ${floor.local}, then build again. If the Paper repository now serves different bytes under that version, replace the fixture: set runtime.api.floor.paper.version and runtime.api.floor.paper.sha256 in pom.xml to a published paper-api 1.19.2-R0.1-SNAPSHOT jar and its SHA-256, and update RuntimeGuardConfigurationTest.
